transcript.text: Hello, welcome back to the On Print Shop Store personalization tutorial series.
In today's video, we will see how you can promote your products and business through promotions.
To meet your business requirements effectively, it's crucial to consistently promote your business products, services, and special offers.
Promotional messages serve as a key marketing strategy that businesses employed to showcase their products or services.
In On Print Shop, we offer you to create four different forms of promotional messages.
Let's see what those are four different forms on the storefront.
As your customers or visitors land on your website and stay on the page for a while, promotional messages appear.
So the start saving promotion as a pop up type of promotional form.
The next form which you can find at the right bottom corner is slider type.
When you click on the plus icon, the offer box will slide in.
The next is the top header one as it appears in the top header position of the page.
And the last one is the toggle one which appears when you scroll the page.

Now, if you're wondering how you can also create such promotional messages and give some good offers to your customers, then let's go to the configuration part and check how it's done in the admin panel.
So the first thing you need to do is enable the promotional message section.
For this, navigate to the Store Configuration section and then click on the Site settings.
In the search box, type Promotional.
Now in this setting, you need to select Yes from the drop down and then save the changes.
When you want to disable this section in the future, you just have to change this value to No and save.
Once this is enabled, you need to go to the Store Personalization and then you can find the Promotional Messages section here.
To create a promotional message, click on the Add button from the top right corner of the screen.
To start with, select if you want to display the message before login, after login, or in both.
The next is to select the page on which you wish to display this message.
Select the type of pages from the first drop down next.
Depending on the first selection, the next drop down menu will display those pages.
Let's select static pages in the first one, then select Home page in the second.
Now it is time to decide the form or pattern of the promotional message.
Do you want to display that in the popup as a slider in toggle style or in the top header section of the selected page?
To see how these patterns will appear on the front door after configuration, you can take the help of this icon.
Depending on the pattern you have selected, you need to make further settings.
For pop up type, you need to define the size of the pop up screen in pixel.
For the slider, you need to define the position of the slider that will be at the top left, top right, bottom left or bottom right.
For the toggle type, you need to set the position to be on the left or on the right.
Let's create a pop up type promotional message.
So select pop up here and then enter the 300 in height and 700 in width.
Now in the time field you need to enter the duration in minutes till which the promotional message will not be displayed once it is closed by the user.
In the delay time, you have to enter the time in seconds such as 5 seconds.
So it is the time after which the message will be displayed if the user stays on the page for the time.
Now give a title to the message such as limited offer.
In the description, you can enter the details of the promotions or add images.
Here let's add an image and enter the message.
Now it is time to set the duration for these promotional messages.
So first enable the promotional message duration and then select the from and to date from the date picker.
Let's create this offer for Christmas.
For that you can select the 21st of December to the 23rd of December as we are creating this for 72 hours.
Finally, enable the status of the message as active and save the configuration.
To verify how this will appear to your customers, let's go to the homepage of your front store.
Let's wait for five seconds and you can see the display of the pop up promotional message for a 50% off offer.
Similarly, you can create other promotional patterns to offer great deals to your customers.
This was all about the promotional messages and how you can create them with different patterns.
See you in the next video.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
